scope: Additive scope expansion for the persistent deterministic Hero, Pet and Equipment integration. This delta imports no new combat statistic and enables no unsourced effect.
game_version: Home Village public documentation consulted 2026-09-23. The existing pinned raw catalogue commit is 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba; its values are not assumed current without item-specific verification.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes (Town Hall 14 Update)
facts: Any available Hero Pet may be assigned to a Hero; one Pet accompanies each Hero into battle.
The source identifies L.A.S.S.I, Electro Owl, Mighty Yak and Unicorn with their initial abilities.
sources.limitations: The launch article does not define every current Pet level, following state transition, collision, target-loss timing or later Pet.

sources.title: The Blacksmith: Hero Equipment & Ore
facts: Each Hero can equip two pieces of Hero Equipment; equipment is upgraded in the Blacksmith.
sources.limitations: The page does not provide complete current per-item level values, activation timing or effect interactions.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Hero Equipment replaces legacy Hero abilities and includes active and passive effects.
sources.limitations: The introductory article does not establish a complete current deterministic contract for the 41-item inventory.

sources.title: August Update
facts: Diggy levels 11 through 15 are TH18 Pet levels.
sources.limitations: This announcement does not publish their combat values or a complete burrow and stun timing contract.

scope_inventory.pets: All 12 permanent Home Village Pets in the frozen 2026-09-17 secondary_inventory_indices pet row; each can be assigned to an included Hero under the primary assignment rule.
scope_inventory.equipment: All 41 permanent Home Village Hero Equipment IDs in the frozen 2026-09-17 secondary_inventory_indices equipment row; per-Hero eligibility remains governed by each source record.
scope_inventory.spawned_subunits: Only documented subunits generated by an included Hero, Pet or Equipment effect; each requires its own source-supported level and lifecycle contract.

derivations.result: 12 Pets and 41 Equipment records enter the active goal inventory
derivations.method: Count the immutable frozen reference's Home Village pet and equipment secondary_inventory_indices rows, then match their IDs to the pinned normalized catalogue; membership does not imply materialization or fidelity.

derivations.result: Diggy L11-15 must be audited in addition to the pinned L1-10 raw table
derivations.method: Apply the official 2026-08-30 TH18 level announcement as an additive inventory requirement; do not synthesize missing numeric values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Materialize all catalogue-only Pet and Equipment records as combat-ready actors or effects.
rejected_inferences.reason: Roster membership and raw fields alone do not establish their complete current deterministic interactions.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the earlier Hero-only phase exclusion as a permanent project exclusion.
rejected_inferences.reason: It documented the boundary of that completed partial phase; the new user-authorized goal explicitly includes Pets and Equipment.

conclusion: The persistent Hero goal now includes all 12 frozen-roster Pets and all 41 frozen-roster Equipment items. Previous Hero behavior remains partial, and catalogue-only Pet and Equipment records remain unmaterialized pending item-specific evidence and tests.
